selected_problem: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED; the native path is still required to produce a semantically correct, machine-valid repository changeset without pretending an optional external accelerator is the core brain.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: The hosted DWAC/UPDIA/TURI execution surfaces were transiently unavailable. The bottleneck family and route therefore remain grounded in the checked-in DWAC controller/router contract plus the fresh canonical evidence boundary from v0.7.0; no hosted execution receipt is fabricated.

code_reality: Taowind Code already had three native synthesis roles (implementation, architecture, verifier) and a federated proposal scorer/selector, but the default DWAC native candidate count was one when no operator override was supplied.
With the optional external accelerator absent, that default reduced the existing federation path to a single native proposal even when the first native attempt returned no executable changeset.
The existing federation selector only accepts a winner with both repository changes and validation commands, so candidate expansion does not bypass validation or delivery authority.
asset_reuse: Reused core/tao-ai-adapter.mjs role prompts and DWAC native bridge; no new model/provider architecture was introduced.
Reused core/federated-generation.mjs for candidate normalization, scoring and winner selection.
Preserved DWAC ChangeSetIR deterministic lowering, RCL authority gates, transactional changesets, validation, rollback and GitHub delivery boundaries unchanged.
changes: DWAC native cognition now runs the implementation role first and returns immediately to the existing federation path when that first proposal already contains both real repository changes and validation commands.

When the first native proposal is unresolved, invalid or failed and no explicit candidate-count override is configured, the existing architecture and verifier roles are added as bounded fallback candidates instead of escalating directly toward human intervention or an external accelerator.

DWAC_NATIVE_CANDIDATE_COUNT remains an explicit bounded operator override from 1 to 3; explicit values preserve deterministic operator control instead of being silently replaced by the adaptive default.
External accelerator candidate behavior is unchanged.
truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. This cycle narrows single-candidate native search fragility; it does not claim that role diversification creates missing semantic code-generation capability.

Architecture/verifier fallback candidates still originate from the same DWAC NaturalConversationRuntime and remain subject to the existing normalization, deterministic ChangeSetIR lowering, RCL authority, real validation, rollback and delivery gates.

The hosted Developer Execution Runtime, UPDIA, TURI and RCL/RNCS provider status calls returned transient HTTP 502 during this cycle; no successful hosted DWAC execution or RCL/RNCS status receipt is claimed.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive external action was performed.
